items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Old Joe Glaser's getting out of the penitentiary... So when he came out, Louie says, 'I'm going to get Joe Glaser...'

ctx.x: But you see Collins -- then this is when Louie learned about the power of attorney, because when he split and left Collins, Collins took his car, and took everything that he had connected with Louie, that he'd accumulated. And so we used to go by and see Louie after this, you know, and he would be sitting up, he'd say, "That's all right." He says,

"Rockwell want me to re-sign with him. He offered me $5,000.00 to sign a contract." He said, "But I'm not going to sign with him." He says, "You know what I'm going to do? Old Joe Glaser's getting out of the penitentiary." He say and he ain't got nothing." And he says, "And I can tell him what to do, because he ain't got nothing."
Because he had been in jail, right?
